verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's vault health reports evaluate vault security and explicitly include Reused Passwords and Weak Passwords reports, run locally on the client. That covers the weak and reused credential parts of the story. However, the evidence shows only on-demand reports, not proactive warnings, and never mentions breached-service or exposed-password detection. Missing for 10: evidence of breach/exposed-password alerts for services in use, proactive in-app warnings rather than on-demand reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
